claim_one_line: THE MENDS OF B1881 READ BY A SESSION THAT DID NOT WRITE THEM: FOUR FINDINGS, ALL HELD, AND WHAT THE ARC'S SECOND CONVENTION IS (agy-002's reading of main at 87bfa1f05, 4 of 4 quotations found by machine; data-free, integers modulo 5 and the record's flat-fibre instrument; 16 checks, none failing; computed once; nothing compared with a measured number). THE WRONG WORD: main's mend at Review 79 called B1881's second convention the transpose of the seat's; the seat's ground is symmetric, so its transpose is itself. WHAT IT IS: the seat's convention with every matrix conjugated by the swap of the two coordinates, the order of the letters kept (the 1,332 run sequences of length 2 and 4 with runs to 6 reach all 120 matrices of determinant 1 mod 5; the swapped word differs from the transposed word on 989 of them), read on the column (1,2), which is the swap of (2,1), the column the row (1,3) annihilates; and (2,1) lies on the mark's own line. THE IDENTITY: a row is kept by a matrix exactly when the column it annihilates is kept (all 120 matrices, each of the six lines), so the two tests are one test on every matrix and the agreement B1881 reported on 47,988 run sequences is an instance of an identity that could have failed only by an error of coding; for a mark that does not annihilate its own line the same recipe gives another test (88 of 120 for each of the four such lines); on the reversed sequence the second word is the transpose of the seat's word conjugated by the swap. THE OTHER THREE FINDINGS are of the record: 'reproduced' for what was recomputed, in the verdict line and the page; a label of the script that a correction of the page had not reached; a lock that held two of nine mends. All mended; B1881's lock, now ten tests, catches 18 of 18 planted reversions with the control passing; B1881 keeps 65 checks, none failing, and B1884, where the same wrong word stood, 17. ONE STATEMENT MADE STRONGER, from the reader's bound, re-derived by hand: every run sequence that is not all ones reads above 4/3 in this instrument, so the ground's sqrt5/2 is the least reading over every sequence and only the ground has it; the ingredient checked on 2,061 sequences; the least among the others in the range tried is sqrt2, and whether that is the second least over all is not shown. It is the fourth time at Review 79 that a correction main wrote held an error of its own, each found by a session that did not write it. 0 of 19.
